purpose: Outcome-independent archive integrity and data-capability acceptance sample; not a strategy evaluation.
selection_rule: Include the six requested major symbols where the registered date has all four official USD-M kline intervals. Add the first two alphabetically sorted 1000*USDT archive symbols whose 1m, 5m, 15m and 1h daily files are all present on that same date. This is archive availability selection only; Binance ticker statistics and current TRADING status are unavailable in this environment. No strategy outcomes were inspected.

trade_sample.selection_rule: First required major in the registered list with a bounded daily archive below 5 MiB, selected before trade-profile calculation.
